question: 在D2固定ReLU特征合同中，仅将全批量GD改为无放回B=32/8小批量，固定n=64、eta=.3与标签噪声，风险最低点t*是否系统性移动？
optimizer: SGD no momentum/no decay; each update samples a uniform subset without replacement; step counts parameter updates; audit risk evaluated on 2048-row fixed audit set.

predictions.P1: For each variance, at least 3/4 B=32 seed cells have 0.8 <= t*_B32/t*_full <= 1.2.
predictions.P2: For at least 2/3 variance values, at least 3/4 B=8 seed cells have t*_B8/t*_full <= 0.9.
predictions.P3: All 24 cells have finite mean risk and an interior t* in steps 1..767.

counts.recipe_units: batch×noise_variance (2×3); seeds are paired stability repeats

boundaries: 仅D2固定ReLU width128/zero-head/MSE、n=64、eta=.3、float64数据；不外推其他n、eta、Adam、动量、learned hidden或test早停。
mini-batch轨迹使用固定训练数据与epsilon，replicate仅改变batch抽样；不把8条轨迹当独立recipe。
analysis_contract: 每cell保存8条audit MSE轨迹、均值、标准误；t*为均值曲线首个全局argmin；与D2全批量同seed/variance配对。
